constitutive_invariant: exact coexposed same-unit joint state identity and support
optional_invariants: higher-order J; exact minority branches; contradiction; conditional tables
known_loss_or_blindness: no intrinsic distance/neighborhood; combinatorial fragmentation; continuous gradients require authorized state treatment
forbidden_interpretation: exactness does not make configurations social classes or prove similarity
failure_conditions: ungoverned unit/exposure; unauthorized state equivalence; rare fact deletion at lossless floor; source-structure counterfeit; hidden similarity metric
lawful_primary_claims: existence/support of exact joint states; exact conditional/J queries
minimum_replay_dependencies: common input; TTAR state semantics; risk set; configuration member manifest; support/uncertainty law

constitutive_invariant: frozen conditional distribution or contrast under explicit condition/risk set/estimand
optional_invariants: asymmetry; subgroup reversal; counterpattern mass; selected J
known_loss_or_blindness: no global topology by itself; conditioning choices can fragment or induce query dependence; sparse cells
forbidden_interpretation: conditional association is not mechanism/pressure causality
failure_conditions: wrong conditioning set; collider/instrument leakage; unsupported cells presented as stable; changed baseline/estimand; exposure mismatch
minimum_replay_dependencies: common input; condition/destination identity; risk set; baseline; support; weights/estimand

constitutive_invariant: declared metric/order/neighborhood relations within one admitted connected domain
optional_invariants: low-dimensional gradient; rank; opposition; compression; interpolation
known_loss_or_blindness: exact rare branches and higher-order conjunction may be compressed; axes rotate; metric/block/category choices are constitutive
forbidden_interpretation: axis/cluster/distance is not class/field/capital or social ontology
failure_conditions: forced disconnected components; unsupported metric/category treatment; block-counterfeit sensitivity; null-indistinction; unstable retained subspace; semantic relabeling used as evidence
minimum_replay_dependencies: common input; metric contract; active/supplementary manifest; connectedness; perturbation/null receipts; replay tolerance

constitutive_invariant: explicit named incidence/adjacency/topology relation with node/edge semantics
optional_invariants: reachability; components; higher-order incidence; coadministration structure
known_loss_or_blindness: metric magnitude and conditional distributions absent unless separately attached; projections can erase hyperedge structure
forbidden_interpretation: network edge is not automatically a social relation or dependence
failure_conditions: node/edge identity ambiguous; unresolved nonedge treated as absence; projection counterfeits relation; threshold instability; source topology misread as social topology
minimum_replay_dependencies: node/edge authority; source structure/routing provenance; threshold/projection contract

constitutive_invariant: probabilistic compression under an explicit model family and class/profile count rule
known_loss_or_blindness: exact contradiction/minority states may disappear; local-independence/model priors create organization; label switching/nonidentifiability
forbidden_interpretation: latent profile/class is not a social class, personality type, or true respondent essence
failure_conditions: unstable/nonidentified solution; heldout value absent; class count post-hoc; hard assignment erases required facts; source block predicts classes
minimum_replay_dependencies: common input; model specification; seed/fit diagnostics; holdout; label-invariant comparison

constitutive_invariant: predeclared pattern equivalence and recurrence criterion over exact or typed relations
optional_invariants: compact higher-order recurrence; local interaction signatures
known_loss_or_blindness: threshold/support choice can erase rare real patterns or explode inventory; selected motifs omit nonselected facts
failure_conditions: post-hoc motif definition; threshold instability; recurrence tracks questionnaire ancestry; null/permutation prevalence high
minimum_replay_dependencies: base relation refs; motif definition; support threshold; null/holdout; ancestry audit

constitutive_invariant: preservation of a named local invariant bundle under an authorized claim-scoped correspondence
optional_invariants: order; topology; conditional shape; motif/signature recurrence
known_loss_or_blindness: literal category/measurement identity may be absent; mapping freedom can make recurrence non-discriminative
forbidden_interpretation: recurrence/signature is not measurement portability, common world-space, mechanism, or homology
failure_conditions: map chosen from outcome; many arbitrary maps fit; local objects not independently frozen; risk-set/estimand incompatibility; component failure
lawful_primary_claims: cross-context recurrence of exactly named invariant(s)
minimum_replay_dependencies: local object refs; transport contract; map family; discriminativeness/null; local risk sets/estimands

constitutive_invariant: source-faithful empirical-unit/measurement/response/provenance identity sufficient to replay views
optional_invariants: source topology; routing/exposure refs; native values
known_loss_or_blindness: deliberately supplies no social compression, similarity, adjacency, latent membership, or recurrence
forbidden_interpretation: substrate is not itself a social-structural representation
failure_conditions: cannot regenerate lawful views; contains hidden analytic equivalence/role/metric; ungoverned identity/exposure
minimum_replay_dependencies: current authority refs; source-native ancestry; TTAR links where derived states are requested
